delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed the source caption/body evidence and all independent pair checks, and actually viewed the final AdaReNet PNG. The input still splits into the vanilla fc=VM(I), mask Mf=Mask(I), and equivariant fe=EQ(I) routes. Upper Mf and lower 1-Mf elementwise multiplications feed the addition and refinement to the final image. Formula labels and the operator legend remain present. Rotation-equivariant convolution and ResNet refinement are grounded in Section 3.2, and the complementary weights in Equation 21. The seven scientific image blocks are independently reconstructed with the recorded resampling; no unsupported connections were found.
